title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion — Episode6 Showtime! A Beleaguered Bride!

meta.Event Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! This chapel sure is beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, they said this is where the audience is supposed to sit. Also, I guess Kanade and Honami are still getting ready...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, that title... “A Beleaguered Bride”...?
What kind of show do they have in store for us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've gotta think it's gonna be all weird and comical since Tsukasa and Rui were part of the brainstorming.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Now, let's welcome in our brides.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's starting!
I can't wait to see them in their dresses♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, Honami looks gorgeous...!
She even chose to wear a veil. This totally feels like a real wedding...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there's Kanade...!
You both look amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait!
I've gotta take some pics and show Ena what happened!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I-I'm having trouble walking in these...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Those heels are a little high.
But you look very pretty in them and they suit you nicely.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm glad you helped me pick them out, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Our vows...?
Oh, the thing about “in sickness and in health”...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
I didn't realize that we'd also be doing that part.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Do you take one another as wedded spouses for better, for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish from this day forth...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Emu? What's she doing...?
Talk about a surprise entrance.

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “I am Count Otori, and I will be helping myself to those young ladies!”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Wait, Count Otori?! As in the vampire who lives in that castle deep in the mountains...?! I'd heard rumors about you liking to feed on young brides, but I didn't think you truly existed...!”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
“You kidnapping monster!
Appearing at a wedding like this means...”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Those girls are about to get kidnapped!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: O-Okay? A vampire who likes to kidnap young brides...? That's what the title was talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah hah! Now, my beautiful brides, come hither and relinquish to yourselves me!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure what we're supposed to do...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the show must already be underway. That means we need to do our best to make it as entertaining as possible...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “No, a vampire! What do you want with us...? I'm so scared... Wh-What do we do?!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami's totally into it!
Alright, let's see what happens next!

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “Heh heh heh! Take a look at that bell over there, my lovely ladies!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What bell? Oh, there's one in the middle of that garden...

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “It produces an absolutely abhorrent sound! It would most certainly cause me to vanish from this place if you were to ring it!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... I've heard somewhere before that wedding bells are supposed to ward off evil spirits and such...

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “However! Ringing it will be no simple matter! Meet my minions!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wh-Where did all these other vampire-looking people come from...?

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
If you wish to ring the bell, you must run!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You can do it, Kanade, Honami!
Show Count Otori who's boss!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (R-Right. I need to protect Ms. Yoisaki by making Count Otori go away...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (S-Starting by running from Emu and the staff playing her minions. Once we reach the bell, we just have to ring it...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's go, Ms. Yoisaki!
We need to reach that bell!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you feel okay, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes, it's just... This dress... It's so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we need to keep running if we don't want to get caught...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Right...
Wait, actually... Emu's minions don't seem to be moving very fast at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Could it be that they're taking how we're moving into account? We are both trying to run in heels...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's awfully nice of them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, look.
The bell's just up ahead...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What?! Emu...?! Did she just leap over our heads...?!)

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “Heh heh heh... You will not get away that easily, my beautiful brides. You shall join me in my castle and supply me with your blood for the rest of your days!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But the bell... We're so close...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What do we do...? Her minions are right behind us... At this rate, we'll be...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“E-Emu... No, Count Otori!
You leave me no choice!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll keep Count Otori busy!
Ms. Yoisaki, you ring the bell...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry about me...!
Please, go...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh no! I-I'm so sorry!
Are you okay, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep running...
I have to ring the bell before Otori and her minions catch up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait, what am I getting all worked up about?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's not like Ms. Mochizuki's in any real danger...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But for some reason, I feel compelled to do what I can for her right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki and Otori are both doing their best to make this show entertaining for everyone watching...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, please don't mind me.
As long as you have fun today, I'll be happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Everyone's been showing genuine concern for me. Not just Ms. Mochizuki...
Mizuki, Otori and a lot of other people too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means I need to show them my appreciation...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, here it is...! I just have to ring this bell and...

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line:
“N-Nooooo!
You rang the bell! How could you?!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki!
Thank you for ringing the bell!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm just glad you're safe.
Also, what happened to Count Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “Grr... Hearing the sound of that bell is making my powers wane... I have no choice but to retreat back to my castle...”

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “However! Despite being rid of me, the journey you are both about to embark upon will undoubtedly test you moving forward...”

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “But... If you truly care for one another, you may just be able to overcome any obstacles you encounter.”

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line:
“I certainly felt that from you just now!
So, I am sure you will have no trouble!”

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line:
“Go and live happily ever after!
I shall take my leave here! Hah hah hah hah!!!”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: That concludes this showing of “A Beleaguered Bride: A Special Wedding Presentation”. Thank you all very much for watching and participating.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The story was kinda weird, but it ended up being really fun! I was on the edge of my seat the whole time♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, definitely!
Honami, Kanade, you both did amazing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, I sort of just let myself go with the flow, but I'm happy to hear that we did okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What did you think, Kanade?!
Did you enjoy our special show?

rows.Speaker: Count Otori
rows.Line: “I am Count Otori, and I will be helping myself to those young ladies!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry about me...!
Please, go...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep running...
I have to ring the bell before Otori and her minions catch up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure how I'd do at first since we weren't told much about what would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I could tell Otori and Ms. Mochizuki were doing their best to make it as entertaining as possible for everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Before I knew it, I felt that I had to do everything I could to save Ms. Mochizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! That's great!
Kanade, your smile's so wonderhoy that it's making me feel super duper happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad to hear that you enjoyed yourself, Ms. Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was nervous about being in an improvisation show... But I'm glad we agreed to do this...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, I was thinking.
Did you know that you're supposed to ring the wedding bell three times?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Once for the betrothed, a second time for their parents and a third time for everyone in attendance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The two getting married ring the bell to show everyone their gratitude for joining them in this blessed celebration.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's ring it two more times!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You only rang it once just now, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know this isn't a real wedding, but I'm happy I got this chance to hang out with all of you today. So, I wanna do something to thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna ring it too!
I'm really glad that you all decided to come enjoy the fair today, so I wanna thank you somehow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! What do you say, Kanade, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nice! Then, Emu, let's go first!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is my second time hearing it, but it sounds very nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it does.
Last time, the sound of the bell wasn't the first thing on our minds.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kanade! Honami!
You two take it from here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It really is a lovely sound... And it's probably echoing for miles...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what would happen during that show, but it ended up being worth the effort.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Not only that, Ms. Yoisaki seemed to really enjoy herself...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A bell that represents gratitude and blessings... I couldn't be happier that she's hearing this sound right now.)
